System I:   ax + by = -7 and cx + dy = -11
System II:  ax + by = 5 and cx + dy = 6
System III: ax + by = 3 and cx + dy = 1

In the three systems of equations above, a, b, c, and d are the same constants in every system. The only solution of System I is (-3, -1), and the only solution of System II is (4, -3). If (x, y) is the solution of System III, what is the value of xy?

A ball is launched straight up from a platform. Its height above the ground, in feet, t seconds after launch is modeled by h(t) = -16t^2 + vt + 8, where v is the launch speed, in feet per second. What is the least whole-number value of v for which the ball reaches a height of at least 100 feet?

A sum of prize money is shared as follows. First, Ana receives $50 plus one-fifth of the money that is left after the $50 is taken out. Next, Ben receives $72 plus one-fifth of the money that is then left after the $72 is taken out. Ana and Ben receive the same amount of money. How many dollars of the prize money are left after Ana and Ben have received their shares?

A car travels 360 kilometers from town A to town B. It drives at a constant speed of 75 kilometers per hour on a highway from town A to a rest stop, stays at the rest stop for 30 minutes, and then drives at a constant speed of 50 kilometers per hour on a country road for the rest of the way to town B. The whole trip, including the time at the rest stop, takes 5 hours 40 minutes. How many minutes after leaving town A does the car arrive at the rest stop?

At a hardware store, every box of screws has the same price. Whenever the total price of a purchase is more than $100, the store subtracts $20 from that total. Lena bought 12 boxes of screws and paid $136. At the same prices, how much, in dollars, would a customer pay for 9 boxes of screws?

The function f is defined by f(x) = 24/(x + 1) - 4. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = g(x) is produced by translating the graph of y = f(x) 4 units to the right and 3 units up and then reflecting the result across the x-axis. What is the value of g(1)?
A line crosses the parabola y = 2x^2 - 5x + 4 at points P and Q, where Q lies to the right of P. The segment PQ has midpoint (3, 15). What is the y-coordinate of Q?

In the xy-plane, the graph of y = a|x - h| + k, where a, h and k are constants, has its vertex at (5, -36) and passes through the point (11, -12). The graph crosses the x-axis at two points. What is the distance between these two points?

At a deli, every sandwich has the same price and every drink has the same price. A sandwich and a drink bought together as a meal deal cost $0.75 less than the sandwich and the drink bought separately. Ana bought 4 meal deals and 2 additional drinks that were not part of a meal deal, and paid $26.50 in all. Ben bought 1 sandwich and 4 drinks, none of them as meal deals, and paid $11.25. What is the price, in dollars, of one sandwich bought separately?

Lines p and q in the xy-plane use the same two numbers, m and n, in opposite roles: line p has slope m and y-intercept n, and line q has slope n and y-intercept m. Line p passes through the point (1, -3), and line q passes through the point (5, -27). What is the y-coordinate of the point on line p whose x-coordinate is -3?

In the xy-plane, the line 9x + 7y = 134 contains the point (a, b), where a and b are constants. The line x - 9y = -166 contains the point whose coordinates are the same two numbers in reverse order, (b, a). What is the value of a + b?

A function f is given piecewise: when x is negative, f(x) = x^2 + bx, where b is a constant, and when x is 0 or greater, f(x) = 2x - 4. Applying f twice, starting with the input 1, gives -12; that is, f(f(1)) = -12. Find f(-5).
Let f(x) = x^2 + 4x - 12, and let g(x) = x + k for some constant k. Exactly two real numbers make the composite f(g(x)) equal to zero: -4 and 4. Compute g(f(5)).

A machine makes rolls at a constant rate, except that every run begins with a warm-up period of 40 minutes during which it makes no rolls. One run lasted 1 hour 20 minutes in all, including the warm-up, and the machine made 320 rolls. How many rolls will the machine make in a run that lasts 3 hours 5 minutes in all, including the warm-up?

Every morning, shuttles leave a station at equal time intervals. The 6th shuttle of the morning leaves at 7:45 a.m., and the 14th shuttle leaves at 9:21 a.m. How many minutes after 6:00 a.m. does the 1st shuttle of the morning leave?

The water from a fountain nozzle follows a path modeled by h(x) = -0.5x^2 + 14x + 3, where h(x) is the height of the water, in feet, above the ground at a horizontal distance of x feet from the nozzle. A lamp post stands on the ground 4 feet closer to the nozzle than the point on the ground directly below the top of the water's arc. How many feet above the ground is the water directly above the lamp post?
